svg.text: CWS 32 C FROM CW SUPPLY HEADER
A = SHORT-STOP XV-104, CLOSE XV-101/102/103, FV-103 TO 0,
FORCE TV-110B / FV-120 / FV-130 OPEN. B = CLOSE XV-101/102, FV-103.
1. SEE PVC-PID-001 NOTES 1-3 FOR THE DESIGN BASIS AND RECIPE, NOTE 8 AND THE SIS TABLE FOR TRIPS. THIS SHEET SHOWS THE R-101 HEAT-REMOVAL SYSTEMS AND THE TEMPERATURE CONTROL.

2. JACKET: CLOSED TEMPERED-WATER LOOP, P-101A/B 470 m3/h (ONE RUNNING; B STARTED BY OPERATOR - AUTO-START TBC). CW 32 C INJECTED THROUGH TV-110B (FAIL OPEN) AND LP STEAM THROUGH TV-110A (FAIL CLOSED) + STEAM MIXER SM-101;
THE SAME MASS SPILLS TO CWR THROUGH BACK-PRESSURE REGULATOR PCV-112 (LOOP 4 barg). FSLL-110 < 120 m3/h FOR 30 s WHILE REACTING -> SIS I-4 (SHORT-STOP).

3. TEMPERATURE CONTROL: TIC-100 (MASTER, R-101 CONTENTS; Kc 10, Ti 1500 s, Td 120 s) SETS TIC-110 (SLAVE, JACKET INLET; Kc 2, Ti 40 s). TY-110 SPLIT RANGE: OUTPUT 0 % = FULL STEAM, 50 % = BOTH SHUT, 100 % = FULL CW.

4. VPC-130 = VALVE-POSITION CONTROL: HOLDS TV-110B NEAR 50 % OPEN BY RESETTING FIC-130, SO THE JACKET KEEPS ITS TRIM MARGIN AND THE REFLUX CONDENSER TAKES THE GROWING LOAD. FIC-130 SP HIGH LIMIT = 12 m3/h PER % OF XI-100
(ANTI-FOAM: TOO MUCH BOIL-UP BEFORE ~10 % CONVERSION CARRIES FOAM AND PVC INTO E-101).
5. BAFFLES: FOUR ADJUSTABLE WATER-COOLED BAFFLES (22 m2) ON ONCE-THROUGH CW, FIC-120 80 m3/h.

6. DESIGN DUTIES AT 2 h (X = 26 %): REACTION 2.71 MW + AGITATOR 0.29 MW = JACKET 1.48 + BAFFLES 0.40 + E-101 0.98 MW. PEAK REACTION 3.43 MW NEAR X = 0.7; THE JACKET ALONE (MAX ~1.8 MW) CANNOT CARRY IT - E-101 ADDS THE MISSING AREA.
7. CW SUPPLY 32 C (TROPICAL DESIGN). E-101 CW RETURN APPROACHES 55 C AT LOW FLOW: MINIMUM-FLOW / SCALING LIMIT TBC WITH THE CW TREATMENT VENDOR.
8. LINE SIZES AND MATERIALS PRELIMINARY - TBC BY PIPING. SERVICE CODES AS PVC-PID-001; LS = LP STEAM.
CHULA CHEM. ENG. - PVC REACTOR VER 1 (OTS)
